problem_type: Model schemas lack a standards-based publication invariant
symptom: The user could not split a manuscript into shots: the whole Agent request was rejected as Invalid request parameters three times.
direct_cause: Two homogeneous fixed-length source arrays were Zod tuples; publication emitted array-valued items. The shared vendor check accepted this shape. Gateway-side causality is still unverified.
class_root: No shared standards whitelist or Zod-derived conversion for unsupported shapes.

MCP consumers of the same tool definitions

door_reduction.why_not: Distinct existing lane, MCP, fingerprint, declaration, provenance and storyboard prompt consumers remain. Every reader was inspected; all retain the shared derivation, schema checks now share the standard whitelist. scripts/check-model-schema.ts is outside door-map roots and checked separately. The initial 11 generated entries were for the existing publisher/vendor collector/transport projection; the after map additionally counts newly centralized normalizer and standard-collector calls, including their owning files. No caller-specific exception or independent schema policy survives.

generality_proof: Shared derivation converts nested tuples, deferred key/string/default constraints and dialect metadata; relocates references; unsupported unknown shapes fail one shared standard collector. Full 54 tool census and unchanged runtime Zod matrix cover both profiles.
